function main()
    numbers = [27, 64, 13, 88, 41, 5, 72, 36]
    total = 0
    for pass = 1:7
        changed = false
        for j = 1:(8-pass)
            if numbers[j] > numbers[j+1]
                numbers[j], numbers[j+1] = numbers[j+1], numbers[j]
                total += 1
                changed = true
            end
        end
        println("pass ", pass, ": ", join(numbers, " "))
        !changed && break
    end
    println("swaps: ", total)
end

main()
